ctx: agent 1: Hi. I'm MJ. Have you heard of Save the Children?
agent 2: I believe I have, yes.

agent 1: It's a charity that directly benefits kids in terms of education, food, etc., especially in war-torn countries. I was hoping I could interest you in donating a portion of your payment today toward it.

agent 1: Ah, the windy city. I'm in Midvale, Utah.
agent 2: Pretty cool. I've never been to Utah.
agent 1: We've got some beautiful national parks here. Lots of crazy rock formations.
agent 2: Yeah I've seen pictures of them. A lot of my friends have done the whole touring the parks out west trip; I just haven't yet.

agent 1: We only have a couple of seconds left. I just wanted to say that it was nice to chat with you.
agent 2: Nice chatting with you too!

agent 1: Would love a good thunderstorm. Very dry here.  Take care, my friend.
